summary: Pole tower with L-4 cab built 1933 on Payette NF; destroyed in 1960; sources disagree on height (10 or 15 feet); no source describes remains.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1960; no source describes remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as Hike-In; no source describes what remains today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 10 feet; Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Idaho County listing (crediting Kresek) give 15 feet. The story reports both figures and does not choose; height_m is left out.

Several Burnt Knob sites exist (Payette NF at 45.46834, -115.28288; a standing NHLR-registered site at 45.70271, -114.99109; a Nez Perce / Bitterroot entry). Only the Payette NF entry in Idaho County is used here.

notes_for_editor: Height is unresolved: 10 feet (firelookout.com) vs 15 feet (Idaho Fire Lookouts; Idaho County listing crediting Kresek). The 1915 staffer named by Idaho Fire Lookouts predates the 1933 tower; the source gives no explanation, and an earlier post on the knob is possible but unproven, so the story only states the dates. A different Burnt Knob (NHLR-registered, standing, Selway / Nez Perce, 45.70271, -114.99109) must not be merged with this record. A 1936 photo caption from the Archival Idaho Photograph Collection appeared only in a search snippet for idaholookouts.weebly.com/burnt-knob1.html and is not in the fetched page text, so no photo entry was added. firelookout.com credits a photo to the Fire Lookout Museum but gives no image URL. Nothing is written about remains because no source describes the site today.
